text:
Maria G: Quick proposal — run a small PLG experiment next week tying: (1) starter prompt packs in the UI, (2) a 30-min office hours webinar, and (3) a targeted free credits drip for new signups who try a prompt. Goal: lift 7-day activation by +8% and capture prompt usage benchmarks. Thoughts?

Sam K: I like it. Can we gate the credit drip on "used starter prompt" event? that makes the attribution clean. also slice by dev vs product personas. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Lucas R: Copy ideas incoming — short headlines for the in-app card + email. keeping it very dev-first. Maybe A/B subject lines:
```
1) "New: Starter prompts to ship your first LLM feature"
2) "Ship an LLM prototype in 10 minutes — free prompt pack"
3) "Starter prompts + credits: try Redwood models now"
```

Eva L: Webinar logistics — I can do a 30-min deck + live prompt breakouts. Recommend we run two office hours: one for weekdays (noon PT) and one for EMEA-friendly slot. Slides & quick demo checklist I can share by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Anita P: For inbound routing, let's send signups who attend webinar + used prompt to sales-lo (MQL) with a tag 'prompt-officehours-APR23'. Non-attenders who used prompt get a nurture sequence. We should also capture the prompt templates they tried in user props.

Maria G: Good call. Ops: can we get unique campaign_id and UTM mapping so reporting is clean? Also want to capture model variant (open vs redwood-optimized) used in the demo.

ops-bot: Campaign created: campaign_id=camp_202604_apr_promptpacks. Please include tag `campaign:camp_202604_apr_promptpacks` in all tracking events. Funnel flow: signup -> in-app card -> used_prompt -> grant_credits -> webinar_attend -> routed_MQL.

Sam K: Tracking + segmentation notes: segment by sign-up source (organic / producthunt / paid), and include `first_model_variant` property. We'll set conversion events for used_prompt and claimed_credit.

Lucas R: Draft email sequences (short) — 1) immediate welcome + 50 credits on using starter prompt, 2) 24h follow-up with webinar invite, 3) 72h nudges with prompt usage tips. Example CTA copy: "Try starter prompt" / "Join office hours" / "See examples".

Eva L: Also design the in-app card creative — small code snippet preview, 1-line benefit, and CTA. I'll attach mock in the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/prompt-pack-mocks (will update).

Maria G: Action items: Lucas — finalize copy + email subjects by tomorrow noon. Eva — share slides + card mock by EOD. Sam & Anita — confirm segmentation + routing rules. Ops-bot — double-check campaign tag in analytics. I'll build the quick experiment plan in the growth board and PR the tracking spec.

Sam K: I'm on segmentation, will post the segment query and routing SQL here when ready.

Lucas R: Copy drafts posted: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/prompt-pack-copy (feedback welcome).

Anita P: I'll coordinate with SEs to have a follow-up checklist for MQLs that includes prompt usage examples.

Maria G: Thanks all — aim to launch the in-app card + credit drip on Monday. Small velocity experiment, we can iterate after first 200 signups. :rocket:
